overview: Having lost her parents at a young age, Nilüfer's dream is to work at the Lutesya Hotel, which her parents built. Kaan, one of the heirs of the hotel, returns to the hotel, which has been ruled by his step-sister Sevil for years, to take revenge. Nothing will ever be the same for Nilüfer and Kaan, whose paths cross here.
title: Çift Kişilik Oda

overview: Carl Matthews is stuck. At the age of 45 his life has become routine. Every morning Carl fights his way onto the 7.39 train where he sees the same unhappy faces doing the same daily commute into Waterloo. Happily married to his best friend from college, Maggie, with whom he has two healthy, if sullen, teenage kids, life for Carl has become predictable. Sally Thorn has recently moved out of London, where she still works as the manager of a health club. But she's unsure if she likes her new suburban life, or the prospect of marriage to Ryan, a handsome personal trainer. Ryan is desperate to start a family, get married, settle down. Sally secretly wonders if he really is the man for her. Not that there's much time to worry about these things, not while she's running to catch the 7.39. Over a fight for a seat Sally and Carl begin talking and suddenly their daily train journeys become a lot more interesting. The 7.39 is the story of how even the most predictable of lives can, in a fleeting moment, dramatically change course.
title: The 7.39
Lian Dan Wo Bu Hui, Zuo Cai Suan Bu Suan

overview: Written, produced and presented by John Nettles, this 3 part documentary coinciding with the 70th anniversary of the German invasion and occupation of the Channel Islands, the only part of the UK conquered by the Germans in the Second World War.
title: The Channel Islands At War

overview: In the early 1970s, Jing Qiu, a girl from a "politically problematic" family, is sent to the countryside for re-education. While documenting village history in Xicunping, she meets the talented and handsome Lao San. Their budding affection faces harsh trials: class stigma, family opposition, and the rigid social hierarchy. Can their promise to reunite under the hawthorn tree ever bloom true?
title: When The Hawthorn Blooms

overview: In 1979, four-year-old Heidi disappears without a trace in Kolding. Heidi has never been found and police are still at large in the case. The year before, 13-year-old Line was abducted in Lyngby. Police find her killed after three weeks. Both the abduction of Heidi and the murder of Line are unsolved, but the cases must never be forgotten. In both cases, we are pursuing the search to find important witnesses who can bring new information about both cases. We have gained access to the Travel Team's confidential journal of Heidi's case, and former Travel Team Manager Hans Jørgen Bonnichsen and several other police officers and witnesses stand up and tell about clues and important turning points in the case - clues that lead all the way to today with new angles and new knowledge about 'The Forgotten Girls'.
title: De glemte piger

overview: A counterfeit artist, also a single father, is forced to work with his ex-lover to craft the perfect $100 bill — all to save his dying daughter.
title: Franklin

overview: Delve into what turns someone into a killer. Whether it was premeditated or spontaneous, a revenge plot or the killer simply snapped, experts uncover the true story behind each killer from the very beginning.
title: The Killer Within

overview: The Chuckle Brothers dressed as giant hounds get into all sorts of adventures and scrapes in this programme aimed at pre-school children.
title: The ChuckleHounds

overview: Russian student Maria Butina unwittingly gets caught in a dangerous political game during her U.S. studies. Arrested, she faces isolation, pressure and interrogation, forcing her to choose between self-interest and loyalty to her homeland.
title: Тюремный дневник

overview: Based on The New York Times best-seller, The Secret Life of Marilyn Monroe begins with the young Norma Jeane Mortenson as she battles a lonely, loveless existence with an absent and mentally ill mother. She ultimately reinvents herself as the sex symbol of an era. A fragile artist, she is very different from the larger-than-life image she portrayed. The great secret of Marilyn's life is that her mother, Gladys, remained a vital -- and troubling -- part of her world. Her marriages to Joe DiMaggio and Arthur Miller collapse in part due to her own inner demons and the onslaught of her mother's illness. As Marilyn cares for her mother, her obsession with President John F. Kennedy leads to a breakdown and hospitalization. Still, she gives the performance of her life as Marilyn Monroe.
title: The Secret Life of Marilyn Monroe

overview: Stillwater follows ex-convict Daniel West, who receives a mysterious letter promising answers about his past and a substantial inheritance in the small town of Stillwater. There he discovers a community where nothing ever ages, no one dies and nobody ever gets out.
title: Stillwater

overview: Vaka centers on the survival of Stockholm's population when an epidemic of insomnia sweeps the city, turning everyone's lives into a waking nightmare of chaos. As the disease spreads, fates and lives collide against an unstoppable threat. While a disgraced prime minister battles to control the city and his image while protecting his reckless son, a dedicated ambulance nurse risks everything to save her infected lover, and a teenage girl defends a young neighbor after his family falls victim to illness and conspiracies.
title: Vaka

overview: A former prisoner named Stary returns to his hometown after 20 years in prison and finds out that he has a daughter, Olya, with limited mobility. In addition, the Old One still has one important unfinished business from 20 years ago. His former accomplice Rakhimov is at large, for whom the Old One just sat down, taking all the blame on himself. Meanwhile, Rakhimov rose decently with the help of the looted money and completely forgot about the existence of his former friend. The district police officer prescribes that the Old man, who is under the supervision of the authorities, must live together with his own daughter. In an attempt to establish a relationship with Olya, the "daddy" persistently begins to help her, but the daughter is not enthusiastic about her newfound father and tries to get rid of a suddenly revealed relative. But gradually she manages to see something human in his actions, a trusting relationship is built between them and both realize that it is the Old One who needs real help and support.
title: Встать на ноги

overview: Cosmetologist Alina Svetlova comes to a sanatorium outside the city to recover from a prolonged bout of bronchitis. And immediately finds herself a suspect in the murder of her ex, Dmitry. Trying to hide the evidence, she crosses paths with former detective Mikhail. Alina must solve the murder case and decide whether to trust Mikhail. He helps her, but he seems to have his own interests…
title: Речная сказка

overview: A person dies twice in life. The first is when their body perishes, and the second is when they fade from the memory of others.
title: Mission to the Moon

overview: Tateishi Haruto, a skilled prosecutor, is mistaken for a molester by Miyashita Sakura on the bus and has a terrible experience. After that, he happens to encounter Sakura, who is fighting after her boyfriend cheated on her, and ends up helping her without thinking... This leads to Haruto having to join Sakura in her drowning binge, and she pushes him down when he's completely drunk! A few days later, Haruto is reunited with Sakura, who has come to take her prosecutor training. Haruto is strict with Sakura, but for some reason he can't leave her alone.
title: Suspicious Partner

overview: Dead-End Job follows, a young man who takes on a seemingly perfect part-time job offering 50 times the usual hourly wage through a mysterious employment agency called Spyder Human Resource Center. However, the job quickly becomes a nightmare as he encounters strange and terrifying phenomena.
title: Dead-End Job

overview: Virgins a wild, warm, and wonderfully awkward ride with four adults who have yet to experience sexual intercourse, as they navigate love, intimacy, and self-discovery in their 30s and 40s.After years of missed connections and dating horror stories, these late bloomers are done playing it safe. They're stepping outside their comfort zones and taking big swings to finally go all the way, emotionally and physically. From navigating awkward first dates to exploring a bondage class and working with an intimacy partner they're putting it all on the line in hopes of finally sealing the deal.
title: Virgins

overview: Youyou was born into a wealthy and loving family, but at the age of ten, tragedy struck—her mother fell to her death, and her father was imprisoned. Ten years later, Youyou discovered that it was An Guoxuan who had orchestrated it all. In a moment of rage, she sought revenge but failed, and accidentally blinded An Guoxuan's son, Qi Dong. In retaliation, Qi Dong heartlessly threw her into the sea. Miraculously, Youyou was rescued by Madam Yu from the Yuan Bi Orphanage and sent abroad. Qi Dong, as An Guoxuan's illegitimate child, was never truly favored. After losing his sight, he was completely cast aside. Yet with sheer determination, he trained himself to function like any other person and eventually founded his own company to rival An Guoxuan's Xingyao Group. Five years later, Youyou returns in glory under the alias "Qi Gege," now a top architectural designer. Major companies compete to recruit her—including Qi Dong's. She pretends to work with him, planning to use him as a stepping stone for revenge. But as they navigate their tangled pasts, Youyou begins to realize that Qi Dong's goal isn't to inherit Xingyao Group. In fact, his mother died because of An Guoxuan too, and he returned to the An family for the same reason as her—revenge. The two finally drop their masks and join forces to take An Guoxuan down. But lurking in the shadows, an even more formidable enemy has begun to make their move…
title: Kill Lover

overview: Relative Secrets investigate an everyday American family's darkest mystery, aiming both to solve the mystery and explore how it shapes that family today. Colorful characters, rich cultural context and dramatic twists and turns abound in every tale, each of which connects the American family to their UK heritage. Along the way, we'll meet charismatic heroes and terrifying villains, ranging from a 99-year-old World War II veteran who worries his absence led to the murder of his grandmother, to the daughter of a serial killer desperate to carve out her own identity from her father's sordid past to a mother who abandoned her three children to start a new secret life.
title: Relative Secrets

overview: In the shadow of a highly publicized tragedy, an eerily similar crime is overlooked. GMA's Robin Roberts shines new light on the victims largely ignored.
title: Murder Has Two Faces

overview: What does it take to become the most influential female podcaster of a generation? Following Alex Cooper as she prepares for her first tour, this compelling two-part documentary series traces Cooper's evolution—from a self-conscious kid growing up in Pennsylvania to the voice behind "Call Her Daddy," a podcast that redefined the conversation for women everywhere. The series offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at the life-defining events that shaped Cooper's journey as she grew from a 24-year-old woman with a sex and dating podcast to the CEO of a media empire in just six years. More than just a success story, it's a portrait of a woman who is creating a space where women feel seen, heard, and empowered.
title: Call Her Alex

overview: Sun, scandal and second chances collide in this reality show in which former cheaters reconnect with their exes. With Amanda Holden and Paul C. Brunson.
title: Cheat: Unfinished Business

overview: Surgical Spirit is a British situation-comedy television series starring Nichola McAuliffe and Duncan Preston that was broadcast from 14 April 1989 through to 7 July 1995. It was written by Annie Bruce, Raymond Dixon, Graeme Garden, Peter Learmouth, Paul McKenzie and Annie Wood. It was made for the ITV network by Humphrey Barclay Productions for Granada Television. The series was based around Sheila Sabatini, a senior surgeon at the Gillies Hospital, whose verbal skills have most people running for cover. She dominated the operating theatre, while at home she was divorcing her Italian husband, Remo, with whom she had a son, Daniel. Sheila was also a gossip, often gossiping with her best friend, theatre administrator Joyce Watson.
title: Surgical Spirit

overview: High-concept relationship sitcom with each episode charting a different key year in the life of Maureen Stevens, over a 14-year time span.
title: Round and Round

overview: BLK: An Origin Story acts as an immersive and informative chapter of Black Canadian history, elevating remarkable Black Canadians previously unacknowledged in mainstream social, academic, and cultural circles, normalizing their unique stories as a matter of general record.
title: BLK: An Origin Story

overview: This series reveals how the Chinese fortress city of Dun Huang moved from an oasis in the desert to a vital commercial bastion.
title: Dun Huang, antigua fortaleza de la frontera

overview: Santi has struggled to survive since childhood. Now, he risks everything to take his startup business to the big leagues. Inspired by true events.
title: Mad Unicorn

overview: A behind-the-scenes look at the series "Heroes" narrated by Anthony Stewart Head.
title: Heroes Unmasked

overview: Ben March's suburban life is transformed when he convinces himself he's been bitten by a werewolf. Though it's unclear whether an actual metamorphosis occurs, Ben embraces his new "wolfman" identity wholeheartedly.
title: Wolfpack of Reseda

overview: Best known for playing Sonia Fowler on EastEnders, Natalie Cassidy will be taking on a new role – but off-screen, fulfilling her genuine ambition of a lifetime to train as a carer. She will study, work and care alongside the next generation of young carers. Natalie will be enrolling at one of the UK's top Health & Social Care colleges where she'll train, study, and work alongside real professionals - facing the realities, the heartbreak, and the joy of caring. Together, her and her fellow students will push open the door to the UK's healthcare providers and put the spotlight on something we all face at some point in our lives - who will care for our parents, who will care for our children... and who will care for us? Will Natalie and her classmates have what it takes to be the next generation of healthcare heroes?
title: Natalie Cassidy: Caring Together

overview: Earnhardt will dive into the rich history of Dale Earnhardt, one of the sport's most influential figures to ever compete at NASCAR's highest level. Through rare archival footage, thrilling races and emotional interviews from his children, colleagues and closest friends, the docuseries will depict Dale Earnhardt's rise to NASCAR stardom and nationwide fame. Earnhardt's navigation of family dynamics — including that of his son, Dale Earnhardt. Jr. — will also be explored.
title: Earnhardt

overview: Prestigious lawyer Amanda suffers a severe OCD breakdown during a high-stakes trial.
title: Perdiendo el juicio

overview: In this escape room comedy show, two teams – Team "Content Creators" and Team "Comedians" – compete against each other, trying to be the first to find their way out of cleverly designed adventure rooms. In each episode, a duo from each team faces off in identically themed settings, where they must prove themselves. Climbing, crawling, swimming – and using their brains – are all part of the challenge. Julien Bam and Joon Kim provide commentary from off-screen.
title: The Way Out

overview: The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realise it is he who will have do change before anything else.
title: Gram Chikitsalay

overview: In each episode, one of Ireland's biggest musical acts will offer the opportunity of a lifetime to an up-and-coming artist – a chance to share the stage as their Support Act. As the Secret Headliner returns to their roots to play a secret gig in a small venue that was central to their journey to success, they have the chance to "give back" by offering support and mentorship to an emerging act who dares to dream. Each episode features the origin story of the Secret Headliner, charting their rise from small venues to hit albums, diamond status streaming, and sold-out arenas and international tours. Hundreds of emerging artists provide a demo song or short set on video for consideration. The Secret Headliner selects their pick and delivers this exciting news personally to their chosen Support Act. The Support Act is now one of the very few people who know the identity of the Secret Headliner. The Secret Headliner selects the venue, a small space that was central to their journey to stardom – it might be the venue where a particular gig led to their record deal, or where they had their first ticketed show – where only 50 people turned up … and half of them were family and friends! Everything then builds to the Secret Headliner gig. The Support Act hones their set, reacts to this huge opportunity, and talks of their hopes and dreams. The identity of the established artist remains a secret to the attending audience until they walk on stage at the Secret Headliner gig. Meanwhile, the event publicist gets the Support Act in front of the press to help raise their profile, build a buzz, and drive an audience for the big show. The tension builds as the Support Act's nerves kick in. The audience begins to queue outside, as soundchecks are completed. Doors open and it's showtime - the biggest gig for the Support Act, a return to the most intimate of performances for The Secret Headliner. The Secret Headliners include Picture This, Cian Ducrot and Belters Only, with the Support Acts being: Simple Things from Kerry, Paddy Keyes from Sligo, and Groveline from Leitrim.
title: The Secret Headliner

overview: Centers around a group of college kids as they are driving on an unfamiliar road. Everything seems fit for a road trip to the lake but, when the group accidentally runs over an unsuspecting squirrel, they quickly realize there will be a price to pay. The cursed road brings the zombie squirrel back to life to terrorize the kids. After the kids crash and everyone is injured except the younger brother, he is forced to set out on a journey to defeat the ancient curse and save his brother and friends before it is too late.
title: Zombie Roadkill

overview: New competition show in which twelve celebrity candidates compete in each programme, all of whom have something special in common, e.g. a TV format, a profession or a passion. Although they are united as a group, they will duel one-to-one in two rounds. In the final, the three best will compete against each other, with the winner receiving prize money totalling 100,000 euros. Elton presents the programme, with Frank Buschmann on the commentary microphone.
title: Eltons 12

overview: It's time to gamble again - and for real money! Stefan Raab welcomes Elton and three other celebrity players to the card table. And you also have the chance to gamble as a wildcard winner in qualifying tournaments. We reveal how it works.
title: Raabs Pokernacht mit GGPoker.de

overview: In this show, Elton, Jens "Knossi" Knossalla and Tim Mälzer compete as a team against real champions: Olympic champions, world champions and world record holders - the celebrities would hardly stand a chance in a one-on-one duel, but as a trio they want to rise to the challenge. Elton, Knossi and Tim Mälzer have to assert themselves against a total of ten champions. The prize for each edition is 50,000 euros. Laura Wontorra will host the new show.
title: Drei gegen Einen - Die Show der Champions

overview: Eight celebrities try to survive 120 hours without light.
title: Licht Aus

overview: At sixty, Pat Krimson looks back on his career. He speaks frankly about the successes and setbacks. About love, friendships, and feuds. About the straight... and the crooked path.
title: Pat Krimson: Bigger and Bolder

overview: What started as a sunny day 25 years ago ended in a devastating disaster. A huge explosion wiped out an entire city district.
title: De Vuurwerkramp

overview: Twelve men think they're taking part in a reality show that hopes to find the "ultimate lad". In fact, their girlfriend's have nominated them for Tool Academy, where they'll be transformed from lazy boyfriends to the perfect partner - or so they think...
title: Tool Academy

overview: A school action drama that depicts the story of a model student who once dedicated all his attention to studying but finds himself entangled in domestic violence and school bullying, compelling him to make a transformative decision. "High School Heroes" pertains to a group formed by the main characters who stand up against school violence perpetrators on behalf of the victims.
title: ONE: High School Heroes

overview: Maeng Gong is the coach of the professional basketball team ‘Big Pandas', which has been on the verge of elimination from the playoffs for three consecutive years. Due to poor performance, he is in danger of being fired. When he was young, he was a star player who attacked boldly on the court, as his name suggests, but now he is more famous as the ‘Young Gong Dae' coaching a professional basketball team. Ko Hwa Jin, a dedicated hater of Maeng Gong, works under the nickname ‘Maeng Gong Extermination Group'. He is a high school student who knows how to analyze the game in seconds. He is a character who has become a malicious commenter, full of hostility and a desire to get revenge on Maeng Gong. With his job on the line, Maeng Gong decides to work with his malicious commenter to achieve team results.
title: A Head Coach's Turnover

overview: Seo Se-Hyun is a genius forensic pathologist. While examining a corpse, she discovers traces of her father Yoon Jo-Kyun who is a serial killer. She desperately attempts to track down her father Yoon Jo-Kyun with Jung Jung-Hyun. He is the chief of the violent crimes team.
title: The Hunter With a Scalpel

overview: Kim, Frédérique et Justine, amies inséparables aux névroses assumées, approchent la mi-trentaine sans parvenir à surmonter leurs insatisfactions. Kim rêve d'amour stable, Fred lutte contre l'anxieté, and Justine déteste son emploi. Leur amitié leur sert de refuge face aux échecs et aux menaces du passé. May this soutien mutuel trop récomfortant les empêche-t-il d'avancer?
title: Gâtées pourries

overview: "Jonge Garde" is about six students attending an exclusive culinary and hospitality academy. Here they are prepared for a successful life in the smartest restaurants. But in order to achieve this, they have to work hard and overcome challenges. You do not become a good chef overnight...
title: Jonge Garde

overview: A comedian recounts how his wit kept him alive inside a brutal juvenile detention center in this raw, coming-of-age drama inspired by true events.
title: Bad Boy

overview: Facing expulsion from their land, a matriarch of a traveling community and her sons fight to save their clan while hiding a dark family secret that could destroy them.
title: Malditos

overview: Watters' World is coming to the weekend on Fox News Channel! Viewers will get a one-of-a-kind comedic look at the latest headlines from the campaign trail. Jesse told "Fox and Friends" that viewers will, of course, see the classic Watters' World packages that they know and love from The Factor. But Watters will also be in-studio with guests to opine on the latest Election 2016 stories. "People get to hear me spout off and hopefully I don't offend too many people," he said. The series will be running once a month for the next year right up until Election Day.
title: Watters' World

overview: Join Yolanthe Cabau on an emotional journey of highs and lows as she leaves the Dutch capital for a fresh start in LA with her 8-year-old son.
title: Yolanthe

overview: In Europe, there is no other place where contrasts and contradictions lie so close to one another as in the region north of the Polar Circle. Brilliant colours, abundant food and hectic activity in the animal world during the polar day form a stark contrast to the soft, muted colours, struggle for survival and icy cold of the polar night. A race against time begins, as the long hours of the bright polar day are as interminable as those of the dark polar night. Both extremes are immensely challenging for both flora and fauna in this landscape – but nature has an answer for everything.
title: Polartag/Polarnacht

overview: Best-selling author and chef Deborah VanTrece introduces viewers to "global soul food," a style of cooking that combines traditional Southern American soul food with different international influences to create something both familiar and new. Her dishes run the worldwide gamut from smothered chicken meatballs over herb truffled spaetzle to paella macaroni.
title: Global Soul Kitchen

overview: In Field to Fire, lifelong outdoorsman and chef Andrew Zimmern heads back into the field to source his favorite proteins. From wild pigs in South Carolina to redhead duck in Texas, culinary icon Andrew Zimmern is geared up to hunt, fish, and harvest everything our country has to offer. After the catch, Andrew will demystify cooking wild food over an open fire while sharing tips for creating the ultimate wild game meal.
title: Andrew Zimmern's Field to Fire

overview: Takubo Yuta works as a drama director at a TV station and has achieved his dream, but he is very busy with work. His former passion has disappeared, and he is living an unstable life, getting irritated all the time. Meanwhile, Sato Kosuke, who was supposed to be doing well as a chef, quietly quit his job and is now living a NEET life. The two meet again when their old friend from high school, Makita Aoi, gets divorced. Then, after a certain incident, they start to just eat dinner together. Through these "dinner activities" (bankatsu), Yuta and Kosuke recover their hearts and get back to their true selves.
title: Bansan Blues

overview: Truth is never black or white. A high-profile case of serial killings takes an unexpected turn when forbidden love and deception come into play. In a world where love can kill, uncovering the truth is more dangerous than ever.
title: Black, White & Gray - Love Kills

overview: 1945. In Nuremberg, the International Tribunal prepares to sentence the German invaders and their accomplices. Igor Volgin, a former frontline intelligence officer, serves as a translator for the Soviet delegation. In the city, Volgin meets Lena, a woman who was forced to work in Germany during the war. While Igor and Lena gradually fall in love, the trial is in jeopardy. The Soviet delegation desperately tries to stop the spies and traitors who are obstructing justice.
title: Нюрнбергская история

overview: The remarkable life and enduring legacy of John F. Kennedy Jr. are explored in this three-part CNN Original Series. American Prince: JFK Jr. traces his early years marked by his father's assassination and the societal and familial pressures to carry the Kennedy torch, through his decision to create George, a new kind of political magazine within the rapidly evolving media landscape of the 90s. It also reveals the love story he shared with Carolyn Bessette, which was relentlessly targeted by media attention. From his charmed early years to his untimely death, this is the untold story of one of America's most iconic and beloved figures.
title: American Prince: JFK Jr.

overview: A look at the legacy of Band Aid, Live Aid and Live 8 in reshaping global charity and politics. Featuring interviews with Bob Geldof, Bono, Sting, and African and western leaders of the time.
title: Live Aid at 40: When Rock 'n' Roll Took on the World

overview: In the greed-fueled landscape of 1980s Los Angeles, a group of young, ambitious men set out to make their fortune—but their lavish dreams quickly spiral into a web of deception, fraud, and murder. Produced by Universal Television Alternative Studio (UTAS), Billionaire Boys Club unpacks the rise and fall of Joe Hunt and the exclusive investment group comprised of privileged 20-somethings whose schemes and crimes led to murder and captivated the media. In an era where fraud and deception have become status quo, Billionaire Boys Club serves as a chilling cautionary tale—revealing what happens when ambition becomes obsession, and a mansion-sized empire is nothing more than a house of cards waiting to collapse.
title: Billionaire Boys Club

overview: Four-part thriller set in Oxford, but not the University, in which young Eddy English tries to find out why someone killed his uncle Big Eddy.
title: The Real Eddy English

overview: Chef Maneet Chauhan walks you through her favorite recipes for all the most craveable Indian dishes, from shopping for ingredients at a local Indian market to serving up dishes in a traditional style.
title: Maneet's Eats

overview: Formula E: Driver is a high-stakes, four-part series following the journeys of four of the sport's biggest personalities: António Félix da Costa, Mitch Evans, Jake Dennis and Dan Ticktum, as they navigate the challenges and victories across Season 10 of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship. Each episode offers viewers a never-before-seen look into the lives of some of the Championship's most prominent figures.
title: Formula E: Driver

overview: Discover the secret Drava Delta: a stunning, diverse wetland teeming with life, where icy alpine rivers meet lush lowland habitats in an untouched European gem.
title: Europe's Amazon

overview: Bob Monkhouse faces members of the public in a unique, no-holds-barred question and answer session.
title: Bob Monkhouse On the Spot

overview: Andréia Horta leads a dive into the history of Brazilian cinema. The actress welcomes filmmakers, directors and performers to discuss their works.
title: O País do Cinema

overview: Anti-fascist resistance and struggle, centered in the north of Portugal, during the 13 years leading up to April 25, 1974.
title: Daqui Houve Resistência

overview: Featuring extensive interviews with the cast and crew, this all-access documentary gives a rare glimpse into the daunting behind-the-scenes efforts that went into the production of the HBO Original smash hit series The Last of Us.
title: Making of: The Last of Us

overview: The renowned architect Deniz and popular editor Güneş, who, on the verge of marriage, experience breakups in their respective lives. However, their lives take a transformative turn when, on the same evening, they cross paths by chance, a message on their phones sets them on a journey that will change everything. This new adventure leads them to uncover the missing pieces in their relationship and rediscover love.
title: Aşkı Hatırla

overview: As tensions erupt between British troops and American colonists, revolution takes root in the actions of bold individuals. Samuel Adams pushes resistance into rebellion, Paul Revere rides to warn the militias, and George Washington prepares to lead a war no one planned for. From political intrigue to battlefield defiance, these men shape the opening shots of the American Revolution and the birth of a nation.
title: Blood on the Bridge

overview: Short Series I Have A Little Story is a series of love stories.
title: I Have A Little Story

overview: At Rome's Fiumicino Airport, security personnel work around the clock to keep Italy's busiest airport free of criminal activity. Italian State Police tackle drug trafficking and illegal immigration at this gateway to Italy and the European Union. And a crack security team remain alert for signs of thieves in the airport's expansive shopping areas. Illegal drugs, fake passports and purloined perfume: it's all in a day's work at Fiumicino.
title: Airport Security: Rome
